faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the District Commissioner Goalpara for filling up administrative vacancies in Assam.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The advertised post is District Administrative Head Assistant under the establishment of the District Commissioner Goalpara.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the District Administrative Head Assistant position in this recruitment cycle.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the offline application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the completed offline application form through the proper channel is 22 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary structure for the Head Assistant post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a salary in Pay Band-3 ranging from Rs. 22,000/- to Rs. 97,000/- with a Grade Pay of Rs. 10,300/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What are the essential qualification requirements?
faq.answer: Candidates must have rendered at least 10 years of service as Senior District Administrative Assistant and 2 years of continuous service as District Administrative Supervisory Assistant.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is offline. Candidates must submit their applications in the prescribed Standard Form via proper channel.

faq.question: Q8. Where should the application form be sent?
faq.answer: The completed application along with required documents must be sent to the Office of the District Commissioner, Goalpara, PO- Baladmari, District- Goalpara, Pin- 783121, Assam.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required to be attached with the application?
faq.answer: Applicants must attach 2 recent passport-size photographs, experience details, Annual Confidential Reports for the last 5 consecutive years, and relevant certificates.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for this position?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates will be selected based on their performance in the interview conducted by the competent authority.
